approvedDeviations.reason: Balance row right group anchors to the cell's right edge via absolute right:0. Figma reports the layer x=214/212; PJS glyph widths are tighter than HarmonyOS Sans (figma's spec font), so the right group's natural width is ~11px narrower than figma's layer width. Right edge matches; left-edge x drifts ~10-12px. Same artifact as account-states harness's buysell deviations.
Same as 可用余额: above — balance row right-amount, anchored to right edge of the 326-wide row. PJS-rendered amount sits ~11px right of figma's HarmonyOS reference.
